MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 34
   C. 17
   D. 66

3. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

4. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 25

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

6. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

12. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 37

15. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 8
   D. 64

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 30

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 36

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 105
   C. 22
   D. 30

20. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

21. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

22. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

23. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 8

24. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
